test: direct symbolic HEAD update bypasses the coordinator on unsupported Git before runtime capability probing exists

fixture.repository: disposable main plus linked peer worktree

command: coordinator run --repo <fixture-main> --operation plan13-red-proof -- env -u SIGRA_BRANCH_WORKTREE_COORDINATOR_TOKEN /opt/homebrew/bin/git -C <fixture-peer> symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main
expected: the linked worktree HEAD remains unchanged and the unsupported executable is rejected before coordinator installation
actual: the old coordinator installed successfully and the direct symbolic-ref changed the linked worktree HEAD while the lock was held
